reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Brutal first experience. Imported an entire trips worth of reservations only to have the app import all the dates wrong!

reviews.title: Fumble
reviews.text:
STILL can’t create an itinerary without having trip dates selected. No flexible scheduling supported for a M-S format.


Yes I’ve asked multiple times over a year+ now. :(

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: There is nothing intelligent about this app. It doesn’t know your tastes, preferences, or budget. If you try to schedule a dining reservation there is no filter capability, for example rated over 4.8/5. Same with activity searches.

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.text: I have found that the app only populates trip itineraries with very specific reservation formats. Anything that varies from those formats does not populate in a trip itinerary and, therefore, the app is a time waster and not a time saver

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text: Tried out Tripsy- It only reads emails with trip information directly in the email text and I am not sure how well it does that. It Does not read email attachments you would get from a tour operator or cruise company. It just loads that into documents and you have to go back and enter each day yourself. It refers to AI parsers but does not provide access to one.  If you only travel once a year and don’t mind loading your itinerary yourself it would be a good reference, but I am trying to save time. Not spend more time.  And who really cares about a changing if background image.

reviews.title: Doesn’t always parse emails correctly
reviews.text: For 2 out of 3 Airbnb reservations within the same trip it said it couldn’t determine which trip to add it to and gave up. I only have one current trip. In the same trip it processed one out of two bus reservations from the same company, but marked it as a train reservation with no way to edit that attribute. I emailed support, who replied quickly (paid pro account) but were able to confirm it should have worked, but didn’t. They said they would have to send it to their email parsing company, which apparently is separate? 5 days later, no update. Doubtful that I will renew my subscription. If it can’t parse emails and I have to enter things manually, the value is greatly reduced.

reviews.title: $7.99 to see all the features
reviews.text: You’ll need to pay for a subscription to try all of the features. Only two options were prominently made available to me in the App when I opened it, one month at $7.99 or one year. There was no free trial period for me, I was immediately charged $7.99, even after immediately ending the subscription within an hour of signing up. Unfortunately, after an hour of checking out the app, it won’t work for me. The shady subscription service is enough to keep me from using this service. But hey, the company did get $8. Maybe that’s their business plan.

reviews.title: Not intuitiv and Problems adding personal events
reviews.text:
Imagine you wanna add a personal appointment without having a specific location. Well, that’s impossible with this app. You can’t create personal events or blockers. It is also not capable of having two manually added stays at the same location on two different dates per stay. And it is not intuitive at all. 
This app doesn’t work for my itineraries and it was just another waste of time.

reviews.title: Won’t fwd emails!
reviews.text: Glitchy. Customer service unable to solve problems. If you can’t forward emails, the main draw is gone!

reviews.title: Beautiful app severely lacking POI data
reviews.text:
Update 29-April-2026:
I appreciate the response from the dev and the tip about the share sheet — wish that was more visible during/after onboarding instead of the numerous banners pushing for the Pro subscription. (Might also be an Apple issue as the share sheet never seems to surface relevant apps for me or my friends…) Also glad to hear that you guys are actively working on improving search and POI information.

If/when I give it another shot, I’ll be sure to reach out to support to provide feedback. Rating won’t change for now, but looking forward to the future of this app. 

OG Review 26-Apr-2026:
I was hoping this could be my replacement for Wanderlog, with a native-first interface, but that kinda fell short.

I was really liked the design, though some of the pop-ups were annoyingly timed/placed causing me to back out of the view I wanted or to enter a view I didn’t want to; honestly, a minor nit. 

My major issue that’s keeping me from using this seriously: lack of POI information — at least for my upcoming trip to Japan. If, like me, you’re coming from Wanderlog, this app feels anemic for POI data. Outside of really big/well-known landmarks and attractions, I felt like there was a 50/50 chance Tripsy would know what I was trying to add to my itinerary. If it doesn’t know what you’re trying to add, manually adding places kinda sucks big time since it was super out of the way (bottom of the list) with no way (or no clear way) to just quickly add an address and move on to

reviews.title: Use Tripit instead
reviews.text: Super manual. Unhelpful. Just use tripit it lets you email your plans and it makes your itinerary for you.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: Free version is full of annoying popups to buy full version…. Deleted

reviews.title: Incredibly poor implementation
reviews.text: The biggest “feature” of being able to automate booking confirmation from your email to saved trips requires you to individually forward the emails to the app. Which doesn’t parse the emails half of the time and makes you enter all the information manually. Completely useless.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: I was excited to try this app to organize my trip but what a disappointment! The email forwarding doesn’t work. It creates a new trip with each email you send and then you have to merge the two trips. You also can’t just notes to a day in your itinerary (e.g. wandering around a certain area with notes where to go). The app forces you to use their rigid search filter. I wished this app was better.

reviews.title: Stop asking for a review
reviews.text: 5 times in the last 10 minutes you have asked for a review. If I click not now then I mean not now. I’ve paid a subscription to use this app which is quite good but I can’t use until I have given you a review   So here it is I hope your happy with the one star. 5 for the app but looses 4 stars for asking for a review every few minutes

reviews.title: Needs Trip Duplication
reviews.text:
Wish I could duplicate current and past trips so I that I don't have to manually put the same things in the new one, same if a friend is using tripsy on their trip and they want to see where I've been.

On my trips I like to make notes and save locations I either plan to visit or that I find interesting so that if I have time when I'm there I can check the app for what's closest, their hours and things to know.

reviews.title: Notifications
reviews.text: I purchased the app so I could get notified of updates and still notifications are inconsistent to nonexistent.   Will be canceling.

reviews.title: AS A Cruising APP?
reviews.text: Extremely unsure friendly app for setting up a cruise. I want my wasted 1 hour back.

reviews.title: Worst experience in an app ever!
reviews.text: We are moving from Tennessee to Las Vegas Nv. I am trying to plan how many stops along Interstate 40 and where to stay along the way. This app. Is not showing me how to do anything other than showing a start date and end date for my total trip. I am cancelling this app. Now!

reviews.title: Upgrade or not very useful
reviews.text: Everything has the pro label on it, so it’s not very useful unless you’re going to upgrade

reviews.title: Doesn’t hit its mark
reviews.text: It’s just not a smooth ux and many basic features seem to be behind paywall. I was hoping this would be my trip case replacement, but it’s not

reviews.title: Challenges with logging trip
reviews.text: I initially likes this product buy increasingly having issues importing my flights and itinerary into the app. I don’t know what has changed. It is not as simple as it was.

reviews.title: Lots of potential
reviews.text: Managing flights and other events in order is a little confusing at first. The biggest problem is that our flight number appended to the Tripsy itinerary said the flight was delayed by 15 minutes when it was not

reviews.title: Don’t bother to share feedback
reviews.text: If you send feedback to improve app you are wasting your time …. They don’t care even though it’s a simple request

reviews.title: Some highs, lots of lows
reviews.text:
I was attracted to the app because of its visual appeal and the award it won. I downloaded the iPad version and logged in using my Apple ID. I then started setting up our family Christmas trip to Rome, and shortly after, several gremlins began appearing.

I'm unsure whether it was because the app uses Apple Maps, but it couldn't locate the Colosseum Museum or the restaurants I had booked for Christmas Eve or Christmas Day (I had to enter them all manually). All of these locations were instantly found on Google Maps.

Subsequently, I subscribed to avoid the hassle of entering everything manually by having booking confirmation emails sent to the app. However, the app failed to recognise my airport parking confirmation email. Now, that email is just stored as a trip document. I haven't bothered with the other booking confirmation emails from the local Roman vendors.

To make things worse, I couldn't log in to the app on my iPhone using my Apple ID for some inexplicable reason. I then had to create a password on my iPad app and use that email and password to log in on my phone.

I mean, I have Apple Wallet tickets for most of the activities we’re doing in Rome (including our accommodation and airport parking), but none of them can be transferred directly from the wallet to the app. 

Lastly, the calendar integration doesn't work with either Apple Calendar or Fantastical. So, go figure.

All this even before the rest of the family has set it up on their devices and used it during

reviews.title: Great to plan your trip - terrible airline updates
reviews.text: Tripsy does a good job managing my travel, yes there is potential for improvements but in general it works. BUT where it terribly fails are the airline updates… delay notifications are 2-3h behind if even at all sent… defeats the purpose.

reviews.title: Stop sending promotional notifications
reviews.text: I have no choice but to uninstall because I see no option of turning off promotions in settings
